## Description

Versioned fixtures for all diagnostic producers and consumers.

Phase: P0 · Effort: M

<!-- falcone-logs:LOG-ING-003 -->

Parent: [LOG-ING](https://github.com/gntik-ai/falcone-logs/issues/2)

## User story

As an SRE, I want controlled telemetry pressure and visible loss, so that an observability outage does not exhaust applications.

## Description

Controlled telemetry pressure and visible loss.

Phase: P1 · Effort: M

## Requirements

- **FR-LOG-ING-003-1**: Producer/gateway buffers and retries must be bounded by bytes, time and policy, with explicit accepted/rejected/sampled/dropped reasons.
- **FR-LOG-ING-003-2**: Application diagnostics must export asynchronously without changing execution results, while existing governed audit blocking semantics remain intact.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exercise hard kill, queue exhaustion, slow broker and poison batches; sanitize before any persistent exporter WAL.
- [ ] Prioritize critical summaries within caps without promising all errors survive arbitrary overload.
- [ ] Expose retry guidance and drain/shutdown budgets; no unbounded synchronous log flush on function completion.

<!-- falcone-logs:LOG-PRV-001 -->

Parent: [LOG-PRV](https://github.com/gntik-ai/falcone-logs/issues/4)

## User story

As a privacy engineer, I want mandatory minimization and redaction, so that logs do not become a secondary secret store.

## Description

Mandatory minimization and redaction.

Phase: P1 · Effort: L

## Requirements

- **FR-LOG-PRV-001-1**: The pipeline must apply allowlists and redaction before Kafka, persistent queues, DLQs, archives and internal diagnostic logging.
- **FR-LOG-PRV-001-2**: Query-bearing request errors must preserve fix-1118 by omitting raw exception messages, stacks, causes and URL/query material.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Inject synthetic keys into nested logs, headers, signed URLs, causes, breadcrumbs and truncation boundaries; scan every persistent sink.
- [ ] A policy-engine failure rejects/drops protected content with safe metadata, never stores an unfiltered fallback.
- [ ] Generic auto-capture cannot bypass producer restrictions; document residual limits of redacting arbitrary unstructured text.
